mechanism: volatility compression followed by directional release can create a transient expansion regime when price exits a Bollinger-within-Keltner squeeze with aligned trend
payer_constraint: participants forced to reprice or unwind after compressed range breaks; hypothesis only
entry_event: previous bar Bollinger envelope contained within Keltner, current bar exits containment and closes through the release band with EMA alignment
regime_no_trade: no prior squeeze, stale/missing data, weak or excessive release impulse, ambiguous direction, trend disagreement, or inadequate cost budget
timeframe: 1h structural baseline; economic horizon must be prospectively frozen
invalidation: 1.25 ATR initial stop; no adverse add or evaluator-owned rescue
exit_policy: 48-bar timeout, favorable-progress ATR/structure trailing and runner; no outcome-selected TP
sizing_turnover: 0.5% equity risk capped at 15% notional; one entry per release transition, 2-bar cooldown
cost_handling: verified round-trip cost authority required; structural move/cost ratio >=1.25

sources.role: separate directional signal from volatility scaling

falsification: prospective squeeze-release intents must add positive net contribution over direction-flip, time-placebo and delayed-entry controls with frozen costs; otherwise reject the specification
